theme: End-of-life and end-of-support tracking for software
itil4: IT asset management; Service configuration management; Supplier management
summary: The tool lists software past or near end of life so owners can plan replacement. CIS 2.2 expects a monthly review; the SOP sets a quarterly review.

theme: Known-exploited vulnerability overlay on the software inventory
itil4: Information security management; Service configuration management
summary: A reference for prioritization: the tool flags old software whose vendor and product appear in CISA KEV so a person can review it first.

theme: Risk acceptance with expiry and independent approval
nist_800_53: RA-7; CA-5; AC-5; SA-22; CA-6; RA-3
summary: The tool lists accepted risks from your exceptions file and rejects a file where the approver is also the requester.

theme: Ownership, evidence and change linkage for lifecycle findings
itil4: Change enablement; Problem management; Service configuration management
summary: The tool lists items with no owner and links each finding to a change reference and a problem reference you supply.
